title: Halal-Friendly Spicy Roasted Korean Beef Bulgogi
description: A crowd-pleasing Korean dish featuring marinated beef roasted to perfection on a hot stone plate.
instructions: Pound the garlic and ginger in a mortar and pestle until well combined.
In a large bowl, whisk together brown sugar, gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and black pepper.
Add the sliced beef to the marinade and mix to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the beef from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Place the beef on a hot stone plate or a cast-iron skillet and roast for 10-12 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
While the beef is roasting, toast the candied orange peel in a small pan over medium heat until fragrant.
Once the beef is cooked, transfer it to a cutting board and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the beef against the grain and serve with toasted candied orange peel on top.
